Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Pdu Id ID of the received Com IPdu. Pdu Info Ptr Length (Sdu Length) of the received Com IPdu and a pointer to the data of the Com IPdu (Sdu Data Ptr). Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value boolean Shall be always true to ensure the Com IPdu is received. Description Reports a received Com IPdu. If this Com IPdu was requested via J1939Rm_ Send Request or the Send Request service operation, a request timeout for this request is stopped. Available via J1939Rm_ Com.h
